responsibility: This AWK library provides the shared parsing and code-generation helpers used by GCC’s option-table generators. It encapsulates the logic for interpreting .opt properties and flags, extracting arguments such as Var/Mask/Enum metadata, computing CL_* flag masks and cl_option bitfields, selecting storage types and offsets for generated gcc_options fields, sanitizing option names into enums, and validating range and state requirements, thereby centralizing the semantics that opt-read and the various opt*-gen scripts rely on when building generated option tables.
